exclude.web/test-results: Playwright per-test output directory written by the run and never read by it

audit.input_rationale: Command is make test-web (Makefile: web-deps runs npm ci from web/package-lock.json; web-typecheck runs tsc; browser-runtime runs npx playwright install chromium into PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH; then Biome lint/format and playwright test with PLAYWRIGHT_ARGS). Worktree inputs, including web/node_modules, are hashed by the helper. External inputs: the Node.js v24.22.1 install that provides node/npm/npx (/usr/local/bin links resolve there), the Python 3.12 standard library used by scripts/validation_resources.py, the task-cache Chromium and headless shell build 1228 prewarmed by make browser-runtime before this run, the system shared libraries Chromium, Node, and Python load, fontconfig configuration and system fonts used by the failed-triage screenshot, /etc/hosts for 127.0.0.1, and the out-of-root targets of symlinks inside those roots (Python sitecustomize in /etc/python3.12, LLVM libraries linked from the shared-library directory, fontconfig's conf.avail, and poppler cMap data). HOME holds no .npmrc or .gitconfig; no HOME config is read by this command. The npm cache (npm_config_cache) is not an input: npm ci installs exactly the lockfile's integrity-pinned packages, and the installed tree is hashed in the worktree. Excluded outputs: web/test-results (Playwright output, not read).
audit.git_rationale: The Makefile evaluates VERSION with git describe --dirty at parse time, so the record is treated as Git-metadata dependent and binds only to the exact recorded head.
